system.description:
When you spend a few days communing with Aratis about a threat facing Stonetop or civilization as a whole, roll +WIS: on a 7+, Aratis reveals the course of action she would have you take; on a 10+, you also hold 2 Sanction.

While acting on her orders, spend 1 Sanction to add +1 to a roll you just made.

success.value: Aratis reveals the course of action she would have you take, and you hold 2 Sanction.

partial.value: Aratis reveals the course of action she would have you take.
